identified_problem: Switzerland suffered major summer floods in 2021 and 2024, damaging property, infrastructure and business assets across river basins and alpine valleys. potential_pain: Without location-level physical-risk analytics, flood and wildfire losses can erode portfolio returns, trigger unexpected drawdowns and complicate risk reporting to institutional clients and regulators.
evidence: Talaix flood and wildfire hazard layers plus historical event intelligence for Swiss and global asset locations, contextualised around the 2021 and 2024 Swiss floods.
relevant_capability: Asset-level climate risk scoring and portfolio screening for floods, wildfires and related perils.
recommended_message: Quantify physical climate risk across Swiss and global portfolios before the next flood season.
fit_score: Pictet Asset Management's scale as a leading Swiss asset manager and its broad real-asset exposures make it a strong candidate for location-aware climate-risk intelligence.
